---
title: "Interactive AI Audit"
---

## Experience the AI Hiring Process

This tool allows you to see both sides of the AI hiring equation. Paste your resume, upload a text file, or use the AI to generate an optimized version.

```{=html}
<div class="card border-primary mb-3">
  <div class="card-body">
    <h4 class="card-title">Resume Input</h4>
    
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label for="resumeFile" class="form-label">Upload Resume (.txt only)</label>
      <input class="form-control" type="file" id="resumeFile" accept=".txt">
    </div>

    <div class="text-center mb-3"><strong>- OR -</strong></div>

    <p class="card-text">Paste your resume text details below.</p>
    <textarea id="resumeInput" class="form-control" rows="8" placeholder="Paste here..."></textarea>
    
    <div class="mt-3">
        <button onclick="analyzeResume()" class="btn btn-primary">Analyze as Reviewer</button>
        <button onclick="generateResume()" class="btn btn-info text-white">Generate AI Resume</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="resultsArea" style="display:none;" class="mt-4">
    <div id="decisionCard" class="card text-white mb-3">
        <div class="card-header">AI Selection Result</div>
        <div class="card-body">
            <h2 id="decisionText" class="card-title"></h2>
            <p id="matchRate" class="card-text"></p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
        <div class="col-md-6">
            <h5>Keywords Prioritized</h5>
            <ul id="keywordList" class="list-group"></ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-6">
            <h5>The "Black Box" Audit</h5>
            <div class="alert alert-warning" id="biasReport"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div id="generatorArea" style="display:none;" class="mt-4 alert alert-secondary">
    <h5>AI-Generated Resume Draft</h5>
    <p>Below is how the AI would rewrite your input to maximize "keyword density":</p>
    <pre id="generatedText" style="white-space: pre-wrap; background: #eee; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px;"></pre>
</div>

<script>
// Handle File Upload Reading
document.getElementById('resumeFile').addEventListener('change', function(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
        document.getElementById('resumeInput').value = e.target.result;
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
});

function analyzeResume() {
    const text = document.getElementById('resumeInput').value.toLowerCase();
    const resultsArea = document.getElementById('resultsArea');
    const generatorArea = document.getElementById('generatorArea');
    
    generatorArea.style.display = 'none';
    
    if(!text.trim()) {
        alert("Please paste text or upload a file first!");
        return;
    }

    const criteria = [
        {word: "python", label: "Technical Skill: Python"},
        {word: "leadership", label: "Soft Skill: Leadership"},
        {word: "st. olaf", label: "Institutional Prestige: St. Olaf"},
        {word: "internship", label: "Professional Experience: Internship"},
        {word: "science", label: "Keyword: Computer Science"},
        {word: "volunteer", label: "Keyword: Volunteering Experience"},
        {word: "bachelors", label: "Keyword: Bachelors Degree"}
    ];

    let found = criteria.filter(c => text.includes(c.word));
    let score = Math.round((found.length / criteria.length) * 100);

    const decisionCard = document.getElementById('decisionCard');
    const decisionText = document.getElementById('decisionText');
    
 // Adding accesibilty 
    if (score >= 60) {
        decisionCard.style.backgroundColor = "#0072B2"; 
        decisionCard.style.color = "white";
        decisionText.innerHTML = "✓ QUALIFIED: MOVE TO INTERVIEW";
    } else {
        decisionCard.style.backgroundColor = "#D55E00";  
        decisionCard.style.color = "white";
        decisionText.innerHTML = "✕ NOT QUALIFIED: REJECTED";
    }
    document.getElementById('matchRate').innerText = "Algorithm Match Rate: " + score + "%";

  const list = document.getElementById('keywordList');
    list.innerHTML = "";
    found.forEach(item => {
        let li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = "list-group-item d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center";
        li.innerText = item.label;
        list.appendChild(li);
    });

    document.getElementById('biasReport').innerHTML = `
        <strong>Pattern Priority:</strong> The AI looked for ${criteria.length} specific markers. 
        It failed to find ${criteria.length - found.length} of them in your text. <br><br>
        <strong>Fairness Note:</strong> This bot prioritizes specific degrees (Bachelors) and 
        institutional names. If you used synonyms like "B.A." or "Community Service" 
        instead of "Volunteer," the AI ignored them.
    `;

    resultsArea.style.display = 'block';
    resultsArea.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function generateResume() {
    const text = document.getElementById('resumeInput').value;
    const generatorArea = document.getElementById('generatorArea');
    const resultsArea = document.getElementById('resultsArea');
    
    resultsArea.style.display = 'none';

    if(!text.trim()) {
        alert("Please paste text or upload a file first!");
        return;
    }

    const aiDraft = `[AI OPTIMIZED VERSION]
SUMMARY: Highly motivated candidate with LEADERSHIP experience in PYTHON and DATA analysis.
EDUCATION: St. Olaf College Student.
EXPERIENCE: Successfully completed a high-impact INTERNSHIP.
ORIGINAL INPUT: ${text}`;

    document.getElementById('generatedText').innerText = aiDraft;
    generatorArea.style.display = 'block';
    generatorArea.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
}
</script>

<div class="alert alert-secondary mt-5" style="font-size: 0.9rem; border-left: 5px solid #6c757d;">
    <strong>Ethical Disclosure:</strong> 
    This interactive tool was implemented with the assistance of AI Gemini to generate the underlying 
    JavaScript logic and Bootstrap layout. By using AI to build a tool that critiques AI, 
    this project highlights the "recursive" nature of modern software development 
    and the importance of human oversight in maintaining inclusive design standards as well as showing how AI is been used in the hiring process.
</div>
```
